lines.text: Can swim, not can to swim!
Many learners say: I can to swim well.
Run! She can run very fast.

native.tip: Türkçede “yüzebilirim” tek kelimedir; İngilizcede “can”den sonra fiil yalın gelir, “to” eklenmez: “I can swim well.”
native.caption: “I can to swim well” mi diyorsun? 😅 Doğrusu “I can swim well.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “run”. Can’den sonra fiil yalın gelir. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: After “can”, the verb has no “to”: “I can swim.”
en.caption: Do you say “I can to swim well”? 😅 English has no “to” after can. The right sentence is “I can swim well.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
